Customer Care

Shipping & returns.

Our guidelines for order processing, protective packaging, domestic dispatch, and returns management.

Order Processing & Packaging

All VanaVeda botanical teas, herbal oils, and supplements are inspected and hand-packed using recyclable corrugated cartons and biodegradable cushioning materials to protect amber glass containers during transit.

Delivery Coordination & Timelines

Orders are dispatched from our regional partner fulfillment centers within 1–2 business days following verified payment confirmation. Standard regional delivery typically arrives within 3–5 business days.

Returns & Exchange Guidelines

To uphold strict sanitary and pharmacopeial standards for ingestible herbs, capsules, and topical oils, returns are accepted for unopened goods in their original sealed packaging within 14 days of receipt. Opened personal care and consumable botanical items cannot be returned unless defective.

Damaged or Defective Items

If an amber bottle, jar, or carton arrives damaged or compromised during freight, please photograph the parcel and notify our care desk within 48 hours at our Contact page. A replacement or credit will be issued promptly.

Current Shopping Bag

Items in your shopping bag are saved locally on your device. To finalize a retail or wholesale order, connect with our care desk for verified regional dispatch confirmation.
